note: Both sets extract the same core facts correctly — the 40W/9W/7W light-output equivalence, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor dimming-bypass requirement — with quotes that support the claims and nothing invented. However, both are padded with near-duplicate claims (Set A repeats the incandescent, HARVEST HOME, and vacancy-sensor claims; Set B repeats all five claims, yielding 10 entries for 5 distinct facts). Set A is therefore the leaner, less redundant set with the same correct content, while Set B adds only trivial duplicates. Both equally miss the Title 24 requirement that high-efficacy luminaires be on their own switch in kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms, and the LED higher-efficacy statement.
